scope: Android/Termux Herdr migration harness only; canonical Android product/runtime files are read-only and tmux remains authoritative until live promotion gates pass.
knownTraps: Linux aarch64 availability is not Android/Termux compatibility proof.
A missing herdr command is a reviewed-installation gate, not authority to improvise an installer.
Do not use cargo install herdr unless the pinned upstream source documents that method.
Do not use curl-pipe-shell as installation proof.
Do not mutate Android device_config, phantom-process limits, or battery policy from this harness lane.
Herdr command/version success proves binary readiness only; it does not prove a persistent server.
Detach/reattach does not prove agent-state detection or Android background survival.
Raw phone evidence remains local and untracked; commit synthetic fixtures and contracts instead.
tmux remains canonical until every promotion gate has same-device evidence.

buildTestDeploy.build: No product build; harness assets are tracked JSON, Markdown, Python, shell, and PowerShell.
buildTestDeploy.deploy: Push reviewed harness changes to the feature branch and update PR #95; do not install Herdr, replace tmux, mutate Android policy, or promote runtime from this lane.

proofCeiling: This map proves ownership, discoverability, workflow and validation commands, artifact paths and traps only; it does not prove an approved installation method, Herdr Android compatibility, server persistence, agent-state detection, background survival, sprint behavior, or tmux replacement readiness.
